# commercetools_insights_configuration (Resource)

Platform Insights exports logs and metrics from your Project to a supported Application Performance Monitoring (APM) provider.

A Project has at most one Platform Insights configuration, so only a single resource of this type should be defined per Project.

See also the [Platform Insights API documentation](https://docs.commercetools.com/api/platform-insights).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "commercetools_insights_configuration" "my-insights-configuration" {
  active = true

  apm_provider {
    type        = "NewRelic"
    event_types = ["Logs", "Metrics"]
    region      = "eu"
    api_key     = var.newrelic_api_key
  }

  apm_provider {
    type        = "Datadog"
    event_types = ["Metrics"]
    site        = "EU1"
    api_key     = var.datadog_api_key
  }

  apm_provider {
    type        = "OtlpHttp"
    event_types = ["Metrics"]
    endpoint    = "https://my-otlp-provider.example.com:14318"

    header {
      name  = "api-key"
      value = var.otlp_api_key
    }
  }

  additional_attribute {
    event_type = "Metrics"
    name       = "team"
    value      = "commercetools"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the Platform Insights configuration is active.
- `additional_attribute` (Block List) An attribute added to the exported events. At most ten attributes can be configured, and each `name` can be used only once. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--additional_attribute))
- `apm_provider` (Block List) An APM provider to export events to. At most five providers can be configured, and each provider `type` can be used only once. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--apm_provider))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The key of the Project the configuration belongs to.
- `last_modified_at` (String) Date and time (UTC) the Platform Insights configuration was last updated.
- `project_key` (String) User-defined unique identifier of the Project.

<a id="nestedblock--additional_attribute"></a>
### Nested Schema for `additional_attribute`

Required:

- `event_type` (String) Event type the attribute is added to. Valid values are `Logs` and `Metrics`.
- `name` (String) Name of the attribute.
- `value` (String) Value of the attribute.


<a id="nestedblock--apm_provider"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apm_provider`

Required:

- `event_types` (List of String) Event types to export to this provider. Valid values are `Logs` and `Metrics`.
- `type` (String) The APM provider type. One of `NewRelic`, `DynatraceSaaS`, `DynatraceActiveGate`, `Datadog`, `Otlp` or `OtlpHttp`.

Optional:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether this provider configuration is active.
- `active_gate_domain` (String) Your ActiveGate domain. Only applies to the `DynatraceActiveGate` provider.
- `active_gate_port` (Number) Your ActiveGate domain port. Only applies to the `DynatraceActiveGate` provider.
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key used to authenticate against the APM provider. Applies to the `NewRelic`, `DynatraceSaaS`, `DynatraceActiveGate` and `Datadog` providers.

The API never returns this value, so it cannot be read back from the Platform. Terraform keeps the configured value in state and is unable to detect that it was changed outside of Terraform.
- `endpoint` (String) Destination for your OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP) provider. Only applies to the `Otlp` and `OtlpHttp` providers.
- `environment_id` (String) Unique user-defined environment identifier of your Dynatrace account. Only applies to the `DynatraceSaaS` and `DynatraceActiveGate` providers.
- `header` (Block List) Header sent when connecting to your OTLP provider. Only applies to the `Otlp` and `OtlpHttp` providers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--apm_provider--header))
- `region` (String) Region in which your NewRelic account is based. One of `eu` or `us`. Only applies to the `NewRelic` provider.
- `site` (String) Website on which your Datadog account is hosted. One of `US1`, `US3`, `US5`, `EU1`, `US1-FED` or `AP1`. Only applies to the `Datadog` provider.

Read-Only:

- `valid` (Boolean) Whether it is possible to send metrics to the APM provider.

<a id="nestedblock--apm_provider--header"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apm_provider.header`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the header.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Value of the header.

The API only returns header names, so this value cannot be read back from the Platform. Terraform keeps the configured value in state and is unable to detect that it was changed outside of Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The Platform Insights configuration is a singleton per Project, so it is
# imported using the Project key.
#
# Provider credentials are not returned by the API: api_key and OTLP header
# values are empty after an import and need one apply to be set again.
terraform import commercetools_insights_configuration.my-insights-configuration my-project-key
```
